## About
American Auto Service is a family owned and operated repair shop on Cobb Parkway in Kennesaw, in the same building as Ace Hardware. We work on import and domestic cars, plus light duty and medium trucks.
There are no bean counters here, and we don't shuffle cars in and out just to look busy. We quote the work your car needs right now, and if you ask, we'll look it over and tell you what we think it may need soon.
When you come back, you'll see the same faces you dealt with before. Just ask for Bob or Jo Ann. We're rated 4 on Google from 31 reviews.

## Services
- General maintenance: Oil changes and routine maintenance for passenger vehicles.
- Cooling system repair: Repairs to keep your engine running at the right temperature.
- Engine and transmission replacement: When an engine or transmission needs to be replaced, we handle it.
- Wheel balance and alignment: Balancing and alignment to keep your car driving straight.
- Shocks and struts: Suspension work for a steadier ride.
- DOT and fleet inspections: Preventive maintenance inspections for DOT and fleet vehicles.
- Truck repair: Repairs for light duty and medium trucks, import and domestic.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with extended warranties?
A: We accept some extended warranties and will deal with them for you. Bring your policy with you and we can check it out.

Q: Where exactly is the shop?
A: We're one mile north of Barrett Parkway on Cobb Parkway, in the same building as Ace Hardware.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, we accept all credit cards.
